notes: CVs list experience newest first, and a role combined with the one it was promoted from.
Skills you have only from a degree are treated as coursework: listed only when a job asks, under a coursework heading.
Limiting words such as “proof of concept” must survive rewording; the studio warns when a letter drops one.
Cover letters keep gaps to one forward-looking sentence and no longer compare years of experience.
New optional Availability field under Model settings → Private details; letters mention it when set.
